name: remctl-reminders
description: Full-power Apple Reminders control via the RemCTL CLI.
long_description: Exposes the RemCTL Apple Reminders CLI to Claude as two annotated MCP tools: `remctl_read` (read-only queries, auto-runnable) and `remctl_write` (create/edit/complete/delete, gated). Supports tags, sections, subtasks, smart lists, templates, recurrence, and opt-in private ReminderKit metadata. Requires the `remctl` binary installed locally (https://github.com/viticci/remctl) and macOS Reminders permission granted to the Claude app.

tools.name: remctl_read
tools.description: Read-only Apple Reminders queries (today, show, search, info, lists, …).

tools.name: remctl_write
tools.description: Create, edit, complete, or delete reminders, lists, smart lists, and templates.

remctl_bin.title: remctl binary path
remctl_bin.description: Absolute path to the remctl executable. Leave blank to auto-detect ~/.local/bin/remctl or PATH.

timeout_ms.title: Per-call timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for a single remctl command.
